title: 强生医疗设备：需求不及预期，收购阿比奥梅德拖累几何？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Johnson & Johnson chairs dipping just a little bit after the company reported revenue for its med tech segment that fell short of expectations. The firm also posting mixed sales for its
segments.zh: 强生股价小幅下跌，因其医疗科技业务营收不及预期。该公司药品销售也表现不一。

segments.en: drugs. Joining us with more is Bloomberg's Madison Muller. What's the read across? Madison, is this purely a J&J story? Is it a consumer story? Why the maybe slight underperformance?
segments.zh: 彭博的麦迪逊·穆勒将为我们分析。这是强生自身的问题，还是消费端的问题？为何表现略显疲软？

segments.en: Yeah, thank you for having me on. I mean, J&J is interesting because it is a really diversified company. The company has both drugs. They also have med tech devices. They make
segments.zh: 强生是一家多元化的公司，既有药品业务，也有医疗科技设备，还生产手术器械。

segments.en: surgical tools. And typically that can be a boon for them. But when one of the units misses, like we saw today, came in a little bit below expectations on the med tech side. That can hurt
segments.zh: 通常这是其优势，但若某个部门表现不佳，比如今天医疗科技业务略低于预期，就会拖累股价和市场参与者情绪。

segments.en: their shares and hurt the sentiment among investors. So one of the reasons that their med tech business is coming in a bit below expectations is because of this company Abiumed that they
segments.zh: 医疗科技业务不及预期的一个原因是其收购的Abiomed公司，该公司生产心脏泵等设备，但出现了一些召回事件。

segments.en: acquired and they made devices like heart pumps and things like that. And there have been some recalls there. There was also a recent study that didn't do as well as people had hoped and
segments.zh: 此外，近期一项研究结果也不及预期，影响了需求。目前来看，这主要是强生自身的问题。

segments.en: that sort of hurt demand as well. So what we're seeing right now is pretty isolated to J&J.
segments.zh: 强生通常是首批发布财报的制药公司之一，因此其业绩可视为行业风向标。但就目前而言，这似乎只是强生的个案。

segments.en: But J&J is typically one of the first pharmaceutical companies to report earnings. And so it can be a little bit of a bell weather for the rest of the sector. Although we, you know, as of right now,
segments.zh: 但强生通常是首批发布财报的制药公司之一，因此可视为行业风向标。不过目前来看，

segments.en: it seems like this is maybe a bit isolated to a J&J situation.
segments.zh: 这似乎只是强生一家公司的问题。
